name: api-catalog-admission
goal: Keep Pages first across every catalog and preserve dedicated preview choices while admitting APIs without legacy aliases.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: API source 58d11d624 inserted apis before Pages despite the entityLabels contract. Full Reports checks reproduced the ordering failure. A separate ChatAgents manifest still prefers agent-creation while its dedicated catalog capture uses component-catalog-previews.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The complete entity-lens ordered matrix already guarded Pages first but omitted the new category. Freeze that matrix with APIs after Pages. The existing all-unit preview projection rejects unavailable registered choices at every viewport. Run both in normal Reports verification; preserve historical route aliases only for categories that had them.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 3e67de3866c67e09f8367eae3649e3c55210d0b7f9b32394c1164cb69843e691 tests d62724b7b5d8963d8cb9d8c0c91a7f23c16b7120. The frozen matrix rejects APIs before Pages and the all-unit preview projection rejects ChatAgents at three viewports.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Move only the APIs label after Pages. Point ChatAgents at its existing dedicated component-catalog state. Keep explicit missing-state gaps, every viewport assertion, and historical route aliases. The normal ordered category matrix and every-unit preview projection are the reusable guards.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
